description: Gem Shop purchase counters and displayed gem quotes for the regular save.
target: Gem Shop purchase counts and current costs

extractions.label: catalog_quotes
extractions.expression: idleon.getAttr('CustomLists').h.MTXinfo.flatMap((group, g) => group.flatMap((rows, s) => rows.map((row, slot) => ({ group: g, section: s, slot, counterId: Number(row[4]), shopName: row[1], purchased: Number(idleon.getAttr('GemItemsPurchased')[Number(row[4])]), displayedCost: Math.round(Number(idleon.getAttr('GemItemsPurchased')[Number(row[4])]) * Number(row[7]) + Number(row[3])) })))).filter(row => [2, 5, 55, 56, 65, 103, 112, 128, 140].includes(row.counterId))
extractions.description: Read catalog rows and saved purchase counts without buying items. Displayed costs add the base price to the purchase count times the price increase, then round. Includes fixed and rising costs, purchase limits, zero counts, and both card packs sharing purchase counter 65. Source: idleon1.24.txt:483288-483291.
